description: Returns the published agency counts in the MORVS Surveillance Orders Register national-security source ledger. Optionally filter by exact series ID and period. Every fact retains the agency label, source, page, quote, method and any qualifier or disagreement. Section 702 targets, FISA orders, national-security letters and border device searches use different units, laws and periods; never add them or treat them as one trend. Section 702 target counts estimate non-US persons abroad; FBI query counting changed. These are aggregate published counts and cannot identify surveillance of a person.

period.description: Optional exact published period for the selected series.

series.description: Optional published series id. Series count different things under different laws and must never be added.

name: national_security_surveillance
title: Get National Security Figures
